title: 看板泳道按查找（lookup）字段分组时，泳道标题显示 "[object Object]"
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a display defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7121174460). Source: seat 3's ux-B work on #36643 (PR #36830). The card's own text names it, and the PR leaves it out.

## What happens

When a kanban board's `swimlaneField` is a reference field (lookup, master-detail), each swimlane heading reads `[object Object]` instead of the referenced record's title.

On main f77d078d, `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx` (~line 1376) builds the swimlane rows with `String(card[swimlaneField])`. An expanded reference value is an object, so every lane gets the same heading, and rows that point at different records fold into one lane.

reach: read from code and from the seat's report, not measured in a browser. It reaches every user of a board an author swimlanes by a lookup field.

## Expected

A swimlane keyed by a reference field shows the referenced record's title, and records pointing at different targets sit in different lanes.

## Acceptance

- The heading of a lookup swimlane shows the target record's display title, with the uncategorized lane unchanged for an empty value.
- The swimlane sort and the collapsed-lane memory key on the reference's id, not its rendered text.
- A cross-swimlane move (`useCrossSwimlaneMove`) writes back the reference id, not the expanded object.
- A test drives a board swimlaned by a lookup field.

This is not the same fix as #36830's `laneKeyOf` reuse: the row headings, the swimlane sort and the cross-swimlane write-back all need the expanded record, so it is its own card.

Dedupe: open issues for swimlane plus `[object Object]` and for swimlane plus lookup return only #36643 (the lane-field picker card), which stays separate.
